description: Search OpenStreetMap for named geographic features — streets, parks, landmarks, rivers, mountains, districts, or any named OSM element — by partial name (case-insensitive). Optionally constrain results to a bounding box. Filter by element type: node (point features like fountains, statues), way (roads, paths, area outlines), relation (complex features like national parks, city boundaries), or all. Returns name, coordinates or centroid, place type, and all OSM tags. Useful for locating specific landmarks or verifying a place exists in a region.

feature_type.description: OSM element type to search: "node" (points), "way" (roads/areas), "relation" (complex features), "all" (default).

lat_max.description: Optional northern boundary latitude to constrain the search area.

lat_min.description: Optional southern boundary latitude to constrain the search area.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1–30, default 10).

lon_max.description: Optional eastern boundary longitude to constrain the search area.

lon_min.description: Optional western boundary longitude to constrain the search area.

name.description: Name or partial name to search for (case-insensitive regex). E.g. "Central Park", "Baker Street", "Eiffel".

name: overpass.search.named

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Search Named Places and Landmarks
